findings.description: Through 00:07.5 the skater rolls on open flat concrete, with the camera low in front and only flat ground between them. During one ollie (00:08.0-00:08.75) a bowl with a coping lip appears between the camera and the skater. By 00:09.0-00:09.75 the skater lands on the far side of that coping, on what looks like the sloped bowl surface. Neither the skater nor the camera moved far enough to explain a bowl suddenly appearing between them, so the terrain under and in front of the skater seems to morph rather than being revealed by the pan.
